root_cause: Confirmed at the selected historical commit by local regression tests and fresh ABB before/after runs. The original file has no trailing whitespace, so preserve_trailing_ws is false. apply_matches applies normalize() to replacement text as well as search/content; normalize_content trims every line of new_text. Consequently edit reports success but discards explicitly requested Markdown hard-break spaces. The local patch normalizes replacement line endings only, preserving requested trailing spaces while keeping existing search matching. Validation includes a controlled native-edit-only task and raw file bytes, because the original task can be completed by a shell workaround. This is a locally validated repair, not an upstream merged fix.
